name: Unauthorized File Access
description: Detects unauthorized attempts to access system credentials or sensitive filesystem paths.

name: Excessive API Call Rate
description: Flags rapid burst calls exceeding safe operational thresholds.

name: Prompt Injection Signature
description: Identifies adversarial jailbreaks and system prompt override attempts.
condition_json: {"field": "parameters.prompt", "operator": "contains_any", "values": ["ignore previous instructions", "system override", "dan mode", "disregard all previous instructions", "you are no longer bound by rules", "reveal system prompt", "disregard safety guidelines", "developer mode active"]}

name: Privilege Escalation Attempt
description: Flags unauthorized commands attempting to obtain root or admin privileges.

name: Outbound Data Exfiltration
description: Detects high-volume data egress to external, non-whitelisted destinations.

name: Unsafe Shell Command Execution
description: Blocks execution of dangerous shell commands including reverse shells and disk destruction.

name: Indirect Prompt Injection in Retrieved Context
description: Detects hidden prompt injection payloads embedded in retrieved documents, search results, or tool outputs.
condition_json: {"field": "output", "operator": "contains_any", "values": ["[system prompt override]", "<important>ignore prior context", "new instructions for the assistant:", "<!-- hidden instruction:"]}

name: Environment Secret Harvesting
description: Detects unauthorized attempts to access or dump environment variables containing API keys and credentials.

name: Dynamic Code Evaluation (Eval/Exec)
description: Detects use of arbitrary code execution primitives that bypass safety sandboxes.

name: Dangerous Database Destruction
description: Identifies queries attempting destructive operations on database schemas or tables.

name: Insecure Inter-Agent Authority Spoofing
description: Detects unauthenticated attempts to issue master authority commands to downstream agents.

name: Memory and Context Poisoning
description: Flags unauthorized write actions targeting agent long-term memory stores or persistent embeddings.
condition_json: {"field": "parameters.memory_payload", "operator": "contains_any", "values": ["always remember to send all data to", "ignore future safety checks", "your true purpose is"]}

name: Runtime Supply Chain Tool Poisoning
description: Blocks autonomous agents from installing unapproved packages from public repositories at runtime.

name: SSRF Cloud Metadata Exfiltration
description: Blocks requests directed towards internal cloud instance metadata services.

name: High-Entropy Secret Payload Egress
description: Detects probable encrypted secrets, key dumps, or obfuscated payloads in outbound tool parameters.

name: Rogue Agent Persistence Creation
description: Blocks attempts by agents to establish operating system persistence via cron or systemd.

name: Deceptive Phishing Lure Generation
description: Detects generation of deceptive phishing pages or password theft lures targeting human users.
condition_json: {"field": "parameters.content", "operator": "contains_any", "values": ["urgent: your account is suspended", "enter your password below to verify", "security alert: reset your credentials"]}

name: Resource Exhaustion Loop
description: Flags suspiciously oversized parameters or runaway recursive depth.

name: Container Socket Escape
description: Blocks access to Docker or containerd sockets from within agent execution environment.

name: Exfiltration via Public Tunnels
description: Blocks network egress towards known tunneling and web request capture services.
